units.source_text: 叫少将君将纸条送与浮舟。

en.t: She had Shosho no Kimi deliver the note to Ukifune.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧也看到了这诗，便劝浮舟：“这诗你应该答复。

en.t: The younger nun also saw the poem and urged Ukifune, "You ought to answer this poem.

units.source_text: 此人非常文雅，你可不须顾虑。”

en.t: This gentleman is very refined, so you need not feel any hesitation."

units.source_text: 浮舟答道：“我的字实在拙劣，怎么可以写复诗呢？”

en.t: Ukifune replied, "My handwriting is truly poor; how could I possibly write a poem in reply?"

units.source_text: 妹尼僧说：“这是失礼的事！”

en.t: The younger nun said, "That would be discourteous!"

units.source_text: 便代她写道：“适才我曾对你说过：此人厌恶人世，实非常人可比。

en.t: So she wrote on Ukifune's behalf: "As I told you just now, this gentleman has renounced the world and is truly unlike ordinary people.
